description: Angular component for configuring map data layers in the Thingsboard UI, including form setup, validation, and editing logic.

classes.name: MapDataLayerDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component for editing map data layer settings with dynamic form controls and validation.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up form controls, and subscribes to form value changes for validation.

methods.name: onDsTypeChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in data source type, updating data keys accordingly.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Adjusts form validators and control states based on current form values and data layer type.

methods.name: updateMarkerTypeValidators
methods.description: Adjusts marker-related form controls based on selected marker type.

methods.name: updateFillTypeValidators
methods.description: Adjusts fill-related form controls based on selected fill type.

methods.name: editKey
methods.description: Opens key editing dialog and updates form control with the result.

methods.name: generateDataKey
methods.description: Generates a new data key with a label based on existing keys.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Closes the dialog and returns the current form settings.
